novelty_flags.one_line: Add direct CTC comparators omitted from the survey—Pasche, Chavez-Demoulin, and Davison (2023) on adjusted CTC inference and Causality in extremes of time series (2024) on differing-tail CTC behavior and unresolved inference—then state precisely why their regimes do not subsume the iid collision experiment.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Proposition 3.1 gives the fixed heterogeneous-tail CTC endpoint cases; Theorem 4.3 uses k=floor(tn), while Theorem 4.4 gives a gap-restricted intermediate-sequence CLT for alpha_2<alpha_1.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Expand the direct CTC survey with Pasche–Chavez-Demoulin–Davison and the time-series CTC paper, and add an explicit non-subsumption paragraph distinguishing iid local collision, marked tail-rank information, and the proposed minimax loss.
Replace the broad LAN request with a displayed candidate marked Poisson intensity/central sequence and make the direction-set result state a concrete limit law or sharp minimax ambiguity formula.
Specify how the bias envelope B_n is calibrated from declared tail-class constants, or label the confidence-set result as conditional on a known envelope and provide a sensitivity version.

recommended_next_step: Revise the CTC literature comparison and sharpen the explicit candidate limit experiment before advancing this field-tier proposal to Stage 0.
